name: label3d
purpose: A chip pinned to a point of a scene, with a leader line to the point. The scene places the chips so that they never overlap.
binds: a text template, as a readout has

text.doc: the chip text, at most 60 characters; {path} takes a state value

on.doc: the id of the body that the chip points at

at.doc: the point in the frame of the body on (or of the world)

tone.doc: the colour of the bar at the left of the chip

show.doc: a state key; the chip shows when its value is true

step.doc: the chip shows from this step of the scene
